title: Turning a pile of documents into a searchable useable knowledge base
summary: DocuBrowser is a tool that transforms a collection of documents into an indexed, searchable knowledge base, allowing users to quickly find information across large document collections through a web-based interface.
problem_solved: Helps users search and navigate through large collections of unstructured documents without manually scanning each file.
why_valuable: Saves significant time by enabling instant full-text search across thousands of documents, making disorganized document piles instantly accessible and usable.
